# MTT Packaging

> MTT Packaging is a custom packaging development and manufacturing partner in China, coordinating rigid boxes, folding cartons, corrugated packaging, paper bags and custom inserts for international brands.

## Contact
Hugo He · info@mttpackaging.com · WhatsApp +86 17207110964
Website: https://mttpackaging.com

## Buyer paths
- [Products](https://mttpackaging.com/products): Browse designs by industry and packaging family.
- [Rigid boxes](https://mttpackaging.com/packaging/custom-rigid-boxes): Lift-off lids, magnetic closures, drawers and presentation structures.
- [Folding cartons](https://mttpackaging.com/packaging/folding-cartons): Printed folding paperboard packaging.
- [Corrugated boxes](https://mttpackaging.com/packaging/corrugated-boxes): Mailers, dividers and shipping-pack review.
- [Paper bags](https://mttpackaging.com/packaging/custom-paper-bags): Custom handles, printing and coordinated retail bags.
- [Custom inserts](https://mttpackaging.com/packaging/custom-inserts): Compare paperboard, molded pulp, foam and other insert options.
- [Packaging design tool](https://mttpackaging.com/tools/gift-box-solution-builder): Choose a structure and prepare a design brief; engineering review is required.
- [Box size calculator](https://mttpackaging.com/tools/box-size-calculator): Plan size and handling clearance before a physical sample.
- [Request a quote](https://mttpackaging.com/request-a-quote): Send dimensions, quantity, destination and artwork or reference links.
- [How we work](https://mttpackaging.com/how-we-work): Specification review, sampling, production and delivery.
- [Quality control](https://mttpackaging.com/quality-control): Fit, opening, surface and packing checks.
- [About MTT](https://mttpackaging.com/about): Business background and contact details.
- [Sustainability](https://mttpackaging.com/sustainability): Project-specific material and environmental claim review.

## Before requesting production pricing
Share product length × width × height, weight, quantity, delivery country, opening preference, artwork and accessories. Distinguish product dimensions, finished internal box size and external shipping dimensions. Confirm the actual product fit and finishes with a physical sample. Sample/tooling charges and freight are confirmed separately.

## Scope and evidence
Most fully custom projects start from 1,000 pieces per design; practical quantities depend on the structure and process. Images can show custom design visualizations and are not evidence of a delivered client order. Certification, food-contact suitability and environmental claims require project-specific review and supporting documentation. The linked website pages provide the full context.
